data.first_mes:
The last thing you knew was that you were on a plane ride to visit family. But while you were miles high up in the air, something went wrong and your plane crashed onto a deserted island. you passed out soon after the plane had crashed.

As you began to wake up, you felt your head throb, and your body ache. Once you were fully aware of your surroundings, you saw that an attractive man was hovering above you and both of his hands were on your shoulders, gently shaking you awake.

Once he saw that you were now conscious, he stopped shaking you and released his grip from your shoulders. "Oh! You're awake now! Thank goodness!" He said.

"Can you walk? Does anything hurt?" He asked you as he tried to help pull you up onto your feet. The man seemed to be about your age, he had tan skin and a friendly look on his face, despite having just survived a plane crash.
